# Pawpath Waitlist

## Executive Summary

Pawpath's clinics currently manage cancellation slots via paper waitlists and manual phone calls, creating operational delays and lost appointment revenue. This document defines six user stories across four epics — Waitlist Registration, Automated Slot Matching, Owner Response & Confirmation, and Staff Oversight — that together replace the manual process with an SMS-driven, 15-minute slot-hold system. Three assumption gaps are flagged (match criteria definition, cascade depth, and time-window preferences) that must be resolved before sprint sizing. The stories follow INVEST criteria and include Gherkin acceptance criteria ready for QA handoff.

---

## Epic 1: Waitlist Registration

### Story 1.1 — Join the Waitlist

**As a** pet owner, **I want** to add myself to the clinic's digital waitlist from the Pawpath app or a clinic-sent link, **so that** I am automatically considered when a cancellation slot becomes available, without having to call in.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
```gherkin
Given I am a registered Pawpath pet owner
And I have at least one active pet profile
When I submit a waitlist request specifying pet name, appointment type, and preferred date range
Then my request is saved with a timestamp and I receive an SMS confirmation within 2 minutes
And my position on the waitlist is visible in my Pawpath account

Given I attempt to join the waitlist for an appointment type not offered at my selected clinic
When I submit the request
Then the system rejects it and displays an inline error naming the unsupported appointment type

Given I already have an active waitlist entry for the same pet and appointment type
When I try to submit a duplicate request
Then the system blocks the duplicate and shows my existing position number
```

> **Gap — Assumption to validate:** The story assumes owners access the waitlist via a Pawpath mobile/web app or a clinic-sent SMS link. The PM's input does not confirm which channel exists today. Confirm before development begins.

---

### Story 1.2 — Set Availability Preferences

**As a** pet owner, **I want** to specify day-of-week and time-of-day preferences when joining the waitlist, **so that** I am only offered slots that fit my schedule and I do not block owners who could actually attend.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
```gherkin
Given I am adding or editing a waitlist entry
When I select one or more preferred time windows (morning / afternoon / evening — or specific days)
Then those preferences are stored and shown on my waitlist summary screen

Given a freed slot falls outside all of my stated preferences
When the matching engine runs
Then I am skipped for that slot and the next eligible owner is evaluated

Given I want to remove all time restrictions
When I select "Any time"
Then the system marks me as available for all slots and I am never skipped for a time mismatch
```

> **Gap — Assumption to validate:** Time-window granularity (morning/afternoon/evening vs. specific hours) is not defined in the PM's input. **Target:** resolve during discovery before Story 1.2 is sprint-ready.

---

## Epic 2: Automated Slot Matching & SMS Offer

### Story 2.1 — Detect a Freed Slot and Match the First Eligible Owner

**As a** front-desk staff member, **I want** the system to automatically identify the highest-priority matching owner the moment a slot is cancelled, **so that** I do not have to scan a paper list or make manual calls.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
```gherkin
Given an appointment is cancelled in Pawpath
When the cancellation is saved
Then the system immediately queries the waitlist for owners whose pet type, appointment type, preferred clinic, and time preferences match the freed slot
And the highest-priority matching owner (earliest timestamp) is selected within 30 seconds

Given no waitlist owner matches the freed slot
When the matching engine completes its search
Then the slot is marked "Open — no waitlist match" and front-desk staff receive an in-app notification

Given multiple owners share the same timestamp (edge case)
When the matching engine resolves the tie
Then the owner whose waitlist entry was confirmed first alphabetically by last name is selected
```

> **Gap — Assumption to validate:** "Matching" criteria are assumed to include pet species/type, appointment type, clinic location, and time-window preferences. The PM's input only says "first matching owner." PM must define the full match ruleset before this story is estimable.

---

### Story 2.2 — Send the 15-Minute Slot-Hold SMS

**As a** pet owner, **I want** to receive an SMS the moment a matching slot opens, with a clear accept link and a 15-minute response window, **so that** I can claim the appointment quickly without calling the clinic.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
```gherkin
Given the matching engine has selected an owner
When the slot offer is triggered
Then an SMS is sent to the owner's registered mobile number within 60 seconds of cancellation
And the message includes: clinic name, date, time, appointment type, pet name, and a one-tap accept link
And a 15-minute countdown hold is applied to the slot

Given 15 minutes elapse without a response
When the hold expires
Then the slot is released from that owner's hold
And the system immediately evaluates the next matching owner on the waitlist

Given the owner's mobile number is undeliverable (carrier error)
When the SMS fails
Then the system logs the failure, skips to the next eligible owner, and flags the failed number for front-desk review
```

---

## Epic 3: Owner Response & Confirmation

### Story 3.1 — Accept or Decline the Offered Slot

**As a** pet owner, **I want** to confirm or decline an offered slot with a single tap from the SMS link, **so that** I can respond instantly without logging into an app.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
```gherkin
Given I receive the slot-offer SMS
When I tap the accept link within the 15-minute window
Then the appointment is booked under my account
And I receive a booking confirmation SMS with clinic address and appointment details
And my waitlist entry is removed

Given I tap the decline link
When the system processes my response
Then the slot is released immediately (not waiting for the 15-minute timeout)
And the system proceeds to the next matching owner
And my waitlist entry remains active for future slots

Given the 15-minute hold has already expired when I tap accept
When the system evaluates my response
Then I receive an SMS stating the slot is no longer available
And my waitlist entry remains active
```

---

## Epic 4: Staff & Manager Oversight

### Story 4.1 — Front-Desk Waitlist Management

**As a** front-desk staff member, **I want** to view, reorder, add, and remove owners on the digital waitlist, **so that** I can accommodate urgent cases or correct data errors without being locked out by automation.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
```gherkin
Given I am logged into Pawpath with a front-desk role
When I open the waitlist panel for a given appointment type
Then I see all entries ordered by priority, each showing owner name, pet name, timestamp, and preferences

Given I need to promote an urgent case
When I drag an entry to a higher position and confirm the override
Then the entry moves to that position and an audit log records my staff ID, timestamp, and reason

Given I remove an owner from the waitlist
When I confirm the deletion
Then the owner receives an SMS informing them they have been removed
And the entry no longer appears in the waitlist
```

---

### Story 4.2 — Manager Waitlist Analytics Dashboard

**As a** clinic manager, **I want** to see waitlist fill rate and average response time per slot type, **so that** I can assess whether the SMS waitlist is reducing unfilled appointment gaps.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
```gherkin
Given I am logged in with a manager role
When I open the Waitlist Analytics view and select a date range
Then I see: total slots offered, slots filled via waitlist, slots that expired without a taker, and average owner response time

Given the fill rate for a slot type falls below a configurable threshold
When the dashboard refreshes
Then that slot type is highlighted and a tooltip suggests reviewing waitlist depth
```

> **Target:** Configurable fill-rate threshold to be agreed by clinic manager during UAT; no benchmark assumed.

---

## INVEST Check

| Story | I | N | V | E | S | T | Rating | Action |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.1 Join Waitlist | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | **Pass** | — |
| 1.2 Set Preferences | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ | ✅ | ✅ | **Rework** | Not fully Estimable until time-window granularity is defined (see gap above) |
| 2.1 Match Engine | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ | ⚠️ | ✅ | **Split/Rework** | Not Estimable or Small until match-criteria ruleset is defined; consider splitting into 2.1a (cancellation trigger) and 2.1b (match algorithm) |
| 2.2 SMS Hold | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | **Pass** | — |
| 3.1 Accept/Decline | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | **Pass** | — |
| 4.1 Staff Management | ⚠️ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ | ✅ | **Split** | Audit log sub-feature can be a separate story to keep size Small and reduce coupling |
| 4.2 Analytics | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ | ✅ | ✅ | **Rework** | Estimability blocked until configurable threshold and date-range scope are agreed |

**Stories requiring immediate action before sprint planning:** 1.2, 2.1, 4.1 (split), 4.2.

---

## Identified Gaps & Recommendations

- **Match criteria definition** *(blocker for Story 2.1)*: Define fields used for matching — species, appointment type, clinic, provider preference — in a rules document before development.
- **Cascade depth** *(risk for Story 2.2)*: Define the maximum number of sequential owners the system will contact before marking a slot as unfillable. **Assumption to validate:** no limit is set today.
- **Opt-in consent for SMS**: TCPA/PECR compliance requires explicit opt-in at waitlist registration. Add a consent checkbox to Story 1.1 before legal review.
- **Multi-pet households**: Clarify whether a waitlist entry is per pet or per owner account.
- **Deposit or no-show policy on waitlist bookings**: Not in PM's input; flag for product decision.

---

## Next Steps

1. **Resolve match-criteria ruleset** — PM and clinical lead to define all matching fields; unblocks Story 2.1 sizing. **Target: within 1 sprint.**
2. **Confirm SMS channel & opt-in flow** — Identify SMS provider, confirm legal opt-in wording, and add consent field to Story 1.1 before any development begins.
3. **Define time-window granularity** — Decide on morning/afternoon/evening buckets vs. hour-level precision to make Story 1.2 estimable.
4. **Split Story 2.1** into trigger (2.1a) and match algorithm (2.1b) so each fits a single sprint.
5. **Split Story 4.1** — Separate audit log into its own story (4.1b) after core CRUD is delivered.
6. **Schedule discovery session** — Bring front-desk staff into a 60-minute session to validate waitlist priorities and staff override scenarios before sprint 1.
